title.narrative: Helpdesk services for Democracy and Human Rights 2019-2021 (2022)
Helpdesk services for Democracy and Human Rights 2019-2021 (2022)

description.narrative: Helpdesken erbjuder stöd i beredningsprocesser, uppföljning, strategiprocesser och annat som Sida-personal kan behöva för att stärka myndighetens arbete i relation till denna tematik och metodstöd för att garantera integreringen av demokrati och rättighetsperspektiven.

The purpose of this assignment is to set up and operate a help desk to provide support to Sida's appraisal, decision-making, dialogue and follow-up processes within the thematic area of Democracy and Human Rights. The support provided will be in the form of short-term services, offered on request from both Sida Head office and Swedish Missions Abroad This is a call-off under this Framework Agreement, for the on-call provision of short-term Help Desk services to Sida and Swedish Missions Abroad in the sub-areas of:
1. Local Democracy and Decentralisation, 2. Political Institutions, Political Participation and a Pluralist Civil Society, 3. State-building and Public Institutions and Administration, 4. Public Financial Management, 5. Human Rights Systems, Human Rights Defenders and Rule of Law, 6. Equal Rights and Non-Discrimination, 7. Freedom of Expression and Access to Information Online and Offline 8. Human Rights Based Approach. Funds for these services will be allocated from the Strategy for Sweden’s Development Cooperation in the Areas of Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law, 2018-2022.
